Senses.Explanation: No right and no wrong: the tail of the transmission verse and the halls' standing refusal — struck by Hongzhi as the one meaning, warned by Ruibai as dead water, and given four happy no-connections by Yuechuang. Hongzhi Zhengjue, on the hundred-grass tip: bright, bright — the patriarch's intent; toward the other, never once one; toward me, never once other — if just this is it, you strike the taboo head-on; if just this is not it, where will you hide? hence no right and no wrong, neither identical nor apart — the one meaning the three-age tathāgatas all proclaim — and I dare ask you: what after all is that meaning? a long pause: the rest is long; I leave it for tomorrow; Dahui Zonggao, preaching to the lay patrons: the thing does not lie in much knowing and much explaining, not in noble or lowly, old or young — Zhaozhou said the hundred-year-old who falls short of me, I teach him; the three-year-old who passes me, I make him my teacher — see how the old ones never clung to an I-can and an I-understand, never raised the wall of I-right and you-wrong: at the founding masters' gate the teaching has no right and no wrong, no self and no other — this cannot be picked out and shown to people, cannot be told to people; Zhenjing Kewen at the summer release: the fifteenth of the fourth month binds, the fifteenth of the seventh releases — in the world's truth there are autumn and summer, binding and release; in the Buddha gate no right and no wrong, no gain and no loss — nothing but wondrous function: when it binds, ninety days with the water dammed and the holy-and-ordinary road cut — who dares cough? if you cough, it must be a cough you know how to cough; when it releases, the ten directions open through, coming and going free — and you must still know where the road-head lies; Yongming Yanshou, in the mirror of the source: all buddha realms course only into the gate of one-mind liberation — in one-mind liberation there are no words, and so no birth-and-death, no afflictions, no aggregates and realms, no beings, no sorrow and joy, no pain and pleasure, no bondage, no coming and going, no right and no wrong, no gain and no loss — down to no awakening, no nirvana, no true-suchness, no liberation. Yulin Tongxiu, commanded by the throne on a rainy night to write, answers with the patriarch's verse and his own cracks verse by verse: mind the same as the realm of space; the showing equal to the space-teaching; certified when space is certified — no right and no wrong — and how do you certify space? the mind turns with the ten-thousand conditions, and the turning can truly be dark — following the flow, recognize the nature, no joy and no sorrow — seeing, hearing, awareness and knowing are the flow — and how do you recognize the nature? not one thought arising, the whole body present; the six roots just stir and clouds cover it — and when the whole body is present, what then? the stepping-stones are not Zhaozhou's bridge; bright moon and clear wind are no comparison; Linquan Conglun, on the birth case: even pointing at heaven and earth, solely noble, solely honored, with no need to appear at the second gate — look closely: how does that compare with, before the lamp was lit and beyond Sound-of-Awe, no name and no surname, no right and no wrong — and even that saves only half; to mount the white elephant and descend toward the palace, leave home, complete the way, teach and deliver — does that not wait on messengers passing words? Ruibai Mingxue, in the question-and-answer record: asked how the dreamless thought-free host is answered, he rules — it is, and you add a head on a head; it is not, and you part waves looking for water — the monk offers: no right and no wrong — is that it? the master turns it back: no right and no wrong — a body perched in dead water; the monk bows: then I have come to Tianchi to carry mud — and he does not look round; Yuechuang Liao, at the patron's request in the Guizhou hermitage: mind the same as the realm of space, certified when space is certified — and what after all is the no-right-and-no-wrong teaching? is it the World-Honored holding up the flower and Kāśyapa's faint smile — happily, no connection; Kāśyapa calling Ānanda and Ānada answering — no connection; Deshan's staff and Linji's shout — no connection; Heshan's drum and Shigong's drawn bow — no connection; since all have no connection, you can use one blade of grass as the golden sixteen-footer and back again.
